title: Miaomiao2 and Miaomiao1 new firmware support
body: Is there a roadmap to support the new device and allow users failing to use a L2 sensor with the modified app to use MM1 firmware 38 (and future versions) or MM2 with xDrip+? (Couldn't find anything opened yet)

comments.body:
Hello,
Yesterday I have order Miaomiao 2 and we can see on their web site about compatibility : https://miaomiao.cool/products/miaomiao2-smart-reader?variant=21342749098043

> MiaoMiao2 is compatible with all major reporting applications (Tomato app xDrip, Spike, and Glimp will soon be supported.) as well as major operating systems iOS and Android. MiaoMiao2 has 99.99% automatic accurate reporting

Do you know if MiaoMiao 2 has the same protocol than MiaoMiao 1 or not ?

There is a beta version of xDrip that can recognise Miaomiao2, but remember, it is a beta version you can find the version here : https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/releases/tag/2019.08.31 And if you now want to buy MM2 remember to use this code to get 10$ off: http://miaomiao.refr.cc/calleb
I think that this still needs one more pr to get merged to start working.

Closing due to inactivity.
Please reopen if needed.
